# SceneTemplate

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.SceneBuilding` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/SceneBuilder/Scene/SceneTemplate.cs#L18)

A reusable scene setup: an ordered list of installers plus any prefabs that come with them.
Applying one is never a one-off. A template can be applied to any scene, as often as you
like - each installer tops up what is missing and leaves what is already there alone - and a
template itself is a lasting thing you can author, save and hand to someone else, either as
a [`SceneTemplateAsset`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-scenebuilding/SceneTemplateAsset) in the project or as a subclass of this in an editor
script.

```csharp

```

## Methods

### Apply() {#apply}

Runs every installer that is not already satisfied, then drops in the template's prefabs.
Safe to run on a scene that already has some of the template in it, and safe to run
twice.

```csharp
public virtual void Apply()
```

[View source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/SceneBuilder/Scene/SceneTemplate.cs#L60)

### Replace() {#replace}

Wipes the active scene and applies the template to the empty result. Destructive - the
caller is responsible for confirming with the user first.
